Samsung Launches New Budget Smartphones and Tablets in India

Samsung has launched two new budget smartphones in India, featuring 6,000mAh batteries, 50MP cameras, and security updates until 2032. Additionally, the company has introduced powerful tablets in India, boasting 11,600mAh batteries and 12GB RAM, with prices starting at ₹1.30 lakh, positioning them as more powerful than many laptops.
